lines.text: Count by tens from zero, then look between the marks.
Tap the line where 0 point 5 5 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 1 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 16 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 600 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 15 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 6 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where one half goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where the square root of 7 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 25. Tap the line where negative 37 goes. Then launch!
